power_clean.instruction_short_text: Power clean: Pull the barbell from the floor with an extending hip drive, then receive it at the shoulders in a partial-depth catch.

Pull the barbell from the floor with an extending hip drive, then receive it at the shoulders in a partial-depth catch.
Reset power clean deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Keep the bar close through the pull
Extend the hips fully before the catch
Receive the bar with elbows fast around the bar
common_faults: Catching in too deep a squat

snatch.instruction_short_text: Snatch: Pull the barbell from the floor to full extension in one continuous motion, then receive it overhead in a single catch.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the barbell on the floor with a wide grip and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Pull the barbell from the floor to full extension in one continuous motion, then receive it overhead in a single catch.
Reset snatch deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Keep the bar close through the pull
Extend the hips fully before dropping under
Lock the bar out directly overhead
common_faults: Receiving the bar out in front of the body

push_jerk.instruction_short_text: Push jerk: Dip and drive the barbell from the shoulders overhead, then re-bend the knees to receive it in a short catch.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the barbell at the shoulders in a front rack position and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Dip and drive the barbell from the shoulders overhead, then re-bend the knees to receive it in a short catch.
Reset push jerk deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Keep the dip short and vertical
Drive straight up through the drive phase
Receive the bar with locked-out arms
common_faults: Dipping forward instead of straight down
Pressing out the lockout with the arms alone
Missing the re-bend on the catch

muscle_up.instruction_short_text: Muscle-up: Pull from a dead hang through the transition, then press out above the support to a full lockout.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, gymnastics rings securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Pull from a dead hang through the transition, then press out above the support to a full lockout.
Reset muscle-up deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Pull the rings or bar to the lower chest
Drive the transition forward over the hands
common_faults: Kipping without a clean pulling phase

toes_to_bar.instruction_short_text: Toes-to-bar: Hang from the bar, then raise the feet to make contact with the bar under control and return to a full hang.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, pull up bar securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Hang from the bar, then raise the feet to make contact with the bar under control and return to a full hang.
Reset toes-to-bar deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Drive from the hips, not just the legs
Return to a full hang each repetition
common_faults: Losing the brace on the return

double_under.instruction_short_text: Double-under: Turn the rope twice per jump with quick wrist rotation at the prescribed cyclical pace.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, jump rope securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Turn the rope twice per jump with quick wrist rotation at the prescribed cyclical pace.
Reset double-under deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Turn the rope from the wrists
common_faults: Turning the rope from the shoulders

rope_climb.instruction_short_text: Rope climb: Pull and step up the rope to the prescribed height, then descend under control.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, climbing rope securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Pull and step up the rope to the prescribed height, then descend under control.
Reset rope climb deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Lock the rope with the feet between pulls
Pull with the arms, stand with the legs
Descend under control, not a free slide
common_faults: Losing the foot lock between pulls

handstand_push_up.instruction_short_text: Handstand push-up: Lower the head toward the floor from an inverted support, then press back to full arm lockout.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight against a wall for support and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Lower the head toward the floor from an inverted support, then press back to full arm lockout.
Reset handstand push-up deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Brace the trunk in the inverted position
Lower under control to the prescribed depth
Press to full lockout each repetition
common_faults: Losing trunk alignment during the descent

burpee.instruction_short_text: Burpee: Drop to a chest-to-floor position, return to standing, then finish with a vertical jump.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, open floor space securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Drop to a chest-to-floor position, return to standing, then finish with a vertical jump.
Reset burpee deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Control the drop to the floor
Drive the feet back underneath the hips
Finish with full hip and knee extension
common_faults: Stepping instead of jumping the feet back

air_squat.instruction_short_text: Air squat: Descend to the prescribed depth under bodyweight alone, then drive to full standing extension.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Descend to the prescribed depth under bodyweight alone, then drive to full standing extension.
Reset air squat deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Track the knees with the toes
Keep pressure through the whole foot
common_faults: Losing trunk position during the descent
Shifting onto the toes and losing balance

neck_flexion_isometric.instruction_short_text: Neck flexion isometric: Hold the head in a neutral position against the band pulling it backwards, pressing gently forwards without letting the head move.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the resistance band securely at head height and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Hold the head in a neutral position against the band pulling it backwards, pressing gently forwards without letting the head move.
Release neck flexion isometric gradually at the end of each hold so the neck returns to neutral under control.
common_faults: Tucking the chin to the chest

neck_extension_isometric.instruction_short_text: Neck extension isometric: Hold the head in a neutral position against the band pulling it forwards, pressing gently backwards without letting the head move.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the resistance band securely at head height and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Hold the head in a neutral position against the band pulling it forwards, pressing gently backwards without letting the head move.
Release neck extension isometric gradually at the end of each hold so the neck returns to neutral under control.

neck_lateral_flexion_isometric.instruction_short_text: Neck lateral flexion isometric: Hold the head upright against the band pulling it sideways, pressing gently into the band without letting the head tilt.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the resistance band securely at head height and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Hold the head upright against the band pulling it sideways, pressing gently into the band without letting the head tilt.
Release neck lateral flexion isometric gradually at the end of each hold so the neck returns to neutral under control.

self_resisted_neck_isometric.instruction_short_text: Self-resisted neck isometric: Press the head gently into the hand in each direction while the hand stops any movement, holding a neutral head position.
instruction_detail_text: Set up in a tall, supported posture and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Press the head gently into the hand in each direction while the hand stops any movement, holding a neutral head position.
Release self-resisted neck isometric gradually at the end of each hold so the neck returns to neutral under control.
common_faults: Pushing hard enough to move the head

clean_and_jerk.instruction_short_text: Clean and jerk: Pull the barbell from the floor to the shoulders in one motion, stand up, then drive it overhead and lock it out.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the barbell on the floor with a shoulder-width grip and establish the prescribed starting position.
Pull the barbell from the floor and receive it on the shoulders in a front squat, then stand up.
Dip and drive the barbell overhead, receive it with locked arms, then recover your feet under the bar.
coaching_cues: Keep the bar close through the pull
Lock the bar out directly overhead

clean.instruction_short_text: Clean: Pull the barbell from the floor and receive it on the shoulders in a full front squat, then stand up.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the barbell on the floor with a shoulder-width grip and establish the prescribed starting position.
Pull the barbell from the floor to full extension, then pull yourself under it into a full front squat.
Receive the bar on the shoulders with high elbows and stand up.
coaching_cues: Keep the bar close through the pull
Meet the bar with high elbows
common_faults: Receiving the bar on the hands

split_jerk.instruction_short_text: Split jerk: From the shoulders, dip and drive the barbell overhead and receive it in a split stance with locked arms.
instruction_detail_text: Take the barbell from the rack on the shoulders with the prescribed grip.
Dip and drive straight up, then split the feet front and back and receive the bar overhead with locked arms.
Recover the front foot, then the back foot, and stand with the bar overhead.
coaching_cues: Lock out as the feet land

power_snatch.instruction_short_text: Power snatch: Pull the barbell from the floor to overhead in one motion and receive it with locked arms above a parallel squat.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the barbell on the floor with a wide grip and establish the prescribed starting position.
Pull the barbell from the floor to full extension in one continuous motion.
Receive it overhead with locked arms, hips above parallel, then stand up.
coaching_cues: Punch the bar up into lockout
common_faults: Bar swinging away from the body

hang_snatch.instruction_short_text: Hang snatch: From standing, lower the barbell to just above the knees, then snatch it overhead in one motion.
instruction_detail_text: Stand with the barbell in a wide grip and lower it to the prescribed hang position above the knees.
Extend the hips and knees explosively and pull yourself under the bar.
Receive it overhead with locked arms in a squat and stand up.
coaching_cues: Weight over the middle of the foot at the hang
Lock the bar out directly overhead
common_faults: Swinging the bar from the hips
Receiving the bar out in front

hang_power_clean.instruction_short_text: Hang power clean: From standing, lower the barbell to just above the knees, then clean it to the shoulders above a parallel squat.
instruction_detail_text: Stand with the barbell in a shoulder-width grip and lower it to the prescribed hang position above the knees.
Extend the hips and knees explosively and pull under the bar.
Receive it on the shoulders with high elbows, hips above parallel, then stand.
coaching_cues: Weight over the middle of the foot at the hang
common_faults: Swinging the bar from the hips

snatch_pull.instruction_short_text: Snatch pull: With a snatch grip, pull the barbell from the floor to full extension without receiving it overhead.
instruction_detail_text: Set up as for the snatch with a wide grip.
Pull the barbell from the floor along the snatch path to full hip and knee extension.
Lower the bar under control and reset between repetitions.

clean_pull.instruction_short_text: Clean pull: With a clean grip, pull the barbell from the floor to full extension without receiving it on the shoulders.
instruction_detail_text: Set up as for the clean with a shoulder-width grip.
Pull the barbell from the floor along the clean path to full hip and knee extension.
Lower the bar under control and reset between repetitions.

overhead_squat.instruction_short_text: Overhead squat: With the barbell locked out overhead in a wide grip, squat to full depth and stand back up.
instruction_detail_text: Take the barbell overhead with a wide grip and locked arms.
Squat to the prescribed depth, keeping the bar over the middle of the foot.
Stand back up with the arms locked.
coaching_cues: Bar over the middle of the foot

copenhagen_plank.instruction_short_text: Copenhagen plank: Lie on your side with the top leg on a bench and lift your hips, holding the body straight on the inside of that leg.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and the inside of your top leg resting on a bench, at the knee for the short lever or the ankle for the long lever.
Squeeze the top leg down into the bench to lift your hips until the body is straight, bottom leg off the floor or resting under the bench.
Hold for the prescribed time or lower and lift for the prescribed reps, then change sides.
coaching_cues: Press the top leg down into the bench
Hips in line with the shoulders
Start at the knee before progressing to the ankle
common_faults: Progressing to the long lever too soon

sled_rope_pull.instruction_short_text: Sled rope pull: Standing still, pull a loaded sled towards you hand over hand on a rope for the prescribed distance.
instruction_detail_text: Stand behind the line holding the rope attached to the loaded sled, feet set and knees bent.
Pull the rope hand over hand, driving with the legs and hips as well as the arms, until the sled reaches you.
Walk the sled back out or reset, and repeat for the prescribed distance.
coaching_cues: Sit back and use the legs
Lay the rope down behind you

atlas_stone_over_bar.instruction_short_text: Atlas stone over bar: Lap the stone, then stand and extend the hips to throw it over a bar set at the prescribed height.
instruction_detail_text: Stand over the stone, wrap your arms around it with the hands underneath, and roll it up onto your lap.
Re-grip high on the stone and stand up, driving the hips forward into the stone.
Extend and push the stone over the bar, then reset for the next repetition.
coaching_cues: Chest over the stone before you stand
common_faults: Lifting off the floor without a lap
Letting the stone drift away from the body

atlas_stone_load.instruction_short_text: Atlas stone load: Lap the stone, then stand and extend the hips to load it onto a platform at the prescribed height.
instruction_detail_text: Stand over the stone, wrap your arms around it with the hands underneath, and roll it up onto your lap.
Re-grip high on the stone and stand up, driving the hips forward into the stone.
Extend and roll the stone onto the platform; take it down safely before the next repetition.
coaching_cues: Chest over the stone before you stand
Finish with the hips, not the arms
common_faults: Reaching for the platform with the arms

axle_deadlift.instruction_short_text: Axle deadlift: Deadlift a thick, non-rotating axle bar from the floor to standing with a double-overhand or mixed grip.
instruction_detail_text: Stand with the axle over the middle of your feet and grip it just outside the legs.
Brace, push the floor away and stand up with the axle close to the legs.
Lock out the hips and knees, then lower the axle under control.
coaching_cues: Squeeze the axle hard before it moves

keg_carry.instruction_short_text: Keg carry: Hug a strongman keg to your chest and carry it for the prescribed distance.
instruction_detail_text: Tip the keg onto its side, lap it or roll it up the thighs, and hug it high on the chest.
Stand tall, brace, and walk with short, quick steps.
Set the keg down under control at the finish line.

keg_load.instruction_short_text: Keg load: Lift a keg from the floor and load it onto a platform at the prescribed height.
instruction_detail_text: Stand over the keg, grip the handles or rims, and pull it to your lap or chest.
Extend the hips explosively to drive the keg up.
Roll or push the keg onto the platform and reset.

strongman_farmers_walk.instruction_short_text: Strongman farmer's walk: Deadlift a pair of loaded farmer's handles and walk them for the prescribed distance.
instruction_detail_text: Stand between the handles, grip them in the centre and deadlift them to standing.
Walk fast with short steps, shoulders packed and trunk braced.
Set the handles down under control at the finish.

frame_carry.instruction_short_text: Frame carry: Deadlift a loaded carry frame and walk it for the prescribed distance.
instruction_detail_text: Step inside the frame, grip the handles and deadlift it to standing.
Walk with short, quick steps keeping the frame level.
Set it down under control at the finish.

conans_wheel_carry.instruction_short_text: Conan's wheel: Lift the arm of the wheel in a front hold and walk it around the circle for the prescribed distance.
instruction_detail_text: Squat under the lever arm and take it in the crook of the elbows against the chest.
Stand up and walk around the circle with short steps.
Set the arm down under control.

husafell_stone_carry.instruction_short_text: Husafell stone carry: Lift the stone to your chest and carry it for the prescribed distance.
instruction_detail_text: Tip the stone up, lap it and hug it high against the chest.
Stand tall and walk with short, quick steps.
Set it down under control.

duck_walk.instruction_short_text: Duck walk: Carry the loaded implement between your legs for the prescribed distance.
instruction_detail_text: Straddle the implement and deadlift it by the handle.
Walk forward with short steps, the implement swinging between the legs.
Set it down under control.

circus_dumbbell_press.instruction_short_text: Circus dumbbell: Clean a thick-handled circus dumbbell to the shoulder and drive it overhead with one arm.
instruction_detail_text: Clean the dumbbell to the shoulder with one hand, using the other to assist if allowed.
Dip and drive the dumbbell overhead to a locked arm.
Lower it to the shoulder and repeat or set it down.

viking_press.instruction_short_text: Viking press: Press the handles of a lever-arm frame from the shoulders to locked arms overhead.
instruction_detail_text: Stand in the frame with the handles at shoulder height.
Brace and press the handles to locked arms.
Lower to the shoulders under control and repeat.

frame_deadlift.instruction_short_text: Frame deadlift: Deadlift the handles of a loaded frame (car deadlift) to full lockout.
instruction_detail_text: Stand in the frame with the handles at your sides.
Brace and push the floor away to stand up.
Lock out the hips and knees, then lower under control.

hercules_hold.instruction_short_text: Hercules hold: Hold two loaded pillars from falling outward for as long as possible.
instruction_detail_text: Stand between the pillars and grip each handle with arms at your sides.
Brace and hold the pillars upright as they are released.
Hold for time; set them back under control.

fingal_fingers_flip.instruction_short_text: Fingal's fingers: Lift each hinged pole from the ground and push it over to the other side.
instruction_detail_text: Deadlift the end of the pole and walk your hands up it.
Push it past vertical so it falls to the other side.
Move to the next pole.

vehicle_pull.instruction_short_text: Vehicle pull: Wearing a harness, or with a rope, pull a vehicle or heavy sled for the prescribed distance.
instruction_detail_text: Attach the harness or take the rope and lean forward into it.
Drive with short, powerful steps to get it moving, then keep it rolling.
Stop at the finish line.

sandbag_to_shoulder.instruction_short_text: Sandbag to shoulder: Lift a sandbag from the floor to one shoulder.
instruction_detail_text: Straddle the bag, grip it and pull it to your lap.
Extend the hips explosively and turn the bag onto one shoulder.
Drop it behind or in front and repeat, alternating shoulders.
common_faults: Lifting with a rounded back off the floor

strongman_log_clean.instruction_short_text: Log clean: Pull the log from the floor to the rack position on the chest.
instruction_detail_text: Set up with the log over the middle of the feet and grip the handles.
Pull it to the lap or belt, then extend the hips to roll it up to the chest.
Finish standing with elbows up, ready to press.

power_stairs_carry.instruction_short_text: Power stairs: Lift a loaded implement up a flight of steps, one step at a time.
instruction_detail_text: Stand on the step above the implement and grip the handle.
Hinge and drive the hips to lift it onto the next step.
Step up and repeat to the top.

gripper_close.instruction_short_text: Gripper close: Close a hand gripper fully, handles touching, for the prescribed reps or a hold.
instruction_detail_text: Set the gripper deep in the hand, the lower handle across the base of the fingers.
Squeeze until the handles touch.
Hold or release under control and repeat.

pinch_block_hold.instruction_short_text: Pinch block: Lift a loaded pinch block with the thumb on one side and fingers on the other, and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Pinch the block with straight fingers and the thumb opposite.
Stand up with it, arm straight.
Hold for time and set it down.

blob_lift.instruction_short_text: Blob lift: Pinch-lift the head of a dumbbell (the blob) and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Grip the blob with the thumb on one face and fingers on the other.
Stand up with it, arm straight.
Hold for time and set it down.

thick_handle_deadlift.instruction_short_text: Thick handle deadlift: Deadlift a bar wrapped in thick handles with a double-overhand grip and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Fit thick handles to the bar where your hands go.
Grip double overhand and deadlift to standing.
Hold for time or lower for reps.

rolling_handle_lift.instruction_short_text: Rolling handle: Lift a loaded rotating handle with one hand and hold it without it spinning out.
instruction_detail_text: Grip the handle in the centre with one hand.
Stand up with it, arm straight, and keep it still.
Hold for time and set it down.

inch_dumbbell_deadlift.instruction_short_text: Inch dumbbell: Deadlift a thick-handled inch dumbbell with one hand and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Grip the handle with the whole hand.
Stand up with it beside you, arm straight.
Hold for time and set it down.

wrist_roller_roll.instruction_short_text: Wrist roller: Roll a weight up on a cord by turning the handle, then lower it under control.
instruction_detail_text: Hold the roller at arm's length at shoulder height.
Turn the handle hand over hand until the weight reaches the top.
Reverse to lower it under control.

hub_lift.instruction_short_text: Hub lift: Pinch-lift a hub loaded on a pin with the fingertips and thumb.
instruction_detail_text: Grip the hub with the thumb on top and fingers underneath.
Lift it straight up off the floor.
Hold or set it down under control.

levering.instruction_short_text: Levering: Hold a sledgehammer or levering bar at the end and raise it to vertical by bending the wrist.
instruction_detail_text: Hold the bar at the end with the head pointing forward.
Raise the head towards you by bending only the wrist.
Lower under control.

vertical_bar_lift.instruction_short_text: Vertical bar: Lift a loaded vertical bar by its top, the hand around the thick end, and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Grip the top of the vertical bar with the whole hand.
Stand up with it, arm straight.
Hold for time and set it down.

towel_hang.instruction_short_text: Towel hang: Hang from towels draped over a bar for the prescribed time.
instruction_detail_text: Drape two towels over the bar and grip one in each hand.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders packed.
Hold for time and step down.

block_weight_pinch.instruction_short_text: Block weight: Pinch-lift a block weight by its sides and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Grip the block with the thumb on one side and fingers on the other.
Lift it straight up, arm straight.
Hold for time and set it down.

plate_pinch.instruction_short_text: Plate pinch: Pinch two or more plates smooth sides out and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Put the plates together smooth sides out and pinch them with the thumb on one side.
Stand up with them, arm straight.
Hold for time and set them down.

barbell_front_raise.instruction_short_text: Barbell front raise: Raise a barbell in front of you to shoulder height with straight arms, then lower it under control.
instruction_detail_text: Stand tall holding the bar at the thighs with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Keeping the elbows almost straight, raise the bar forward to shoulder height.
Lower it back to the thighs under control.
common_faults: Leaning back to swing it up
Dropping the bar on the way down

cable_front_raise.instruction_short_text: Cable front raise: Raise a cable handle in front of you to shoulder height, then lower it slowly against the cable's pull.
instruction_detail_text: Stand facing away from a low pulley with the handle between your legs, or one hand at a time.
Raise the handle forward with a nearly straight arm to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, keeping tension on the cable.
common_faults: Raising above shoulder height with a shrug

suspension_front_raise.instruction_short_text: Suspension front raise: Lean back holding the straps, then raise your straight arms overhead to pull your body upright.
instruction_detail_text: Face the anchor holding the handles with straight arms and lean back to the prescribed angle.
Keeping the arms straight and the body in one line, raise the arms forward and up.
Lower back to the lean under control.

seated_barbell_overhead_press.instruction_short_text: Seated barbell overhead press: Sit on an upright bench and press a barbell from the front of the shoulders to locked arms overhead.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with your back against an upright bench and unrack the bar at upper-chest height.
Brace, then press the bar straight up, moving your head back just enough to clear it.
Lock out over the back of your head and lower to the upper chest under control.

seated_dumbbell_shoulder_press.instruction_short_text: Seated dumbbell shoulder press: Sit on an upright bench and press two dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead.
instruction_detail_text: Sit upright with the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward or facing in.
Press both dumbbells up until the arms are straight above the shoulders.
Lower them to shoulder height under control.

smith_machine_shoulder_press.instruction_short_text: Smith machine shoulder press: Press the Smith bar from the front of the shoulders to straight arms from an upright bench.
instruction_detail_text: Set an upright bench under the Smith bar so it lowers to your upper chest.
Unhook the bar, brace and press it up to straight arms.
Lower to the upper chest under control and re-hook at the end.
coaching_cues: Bench set so the bar clears your face
common_faults: Bench too far forward or back

cable_shoulder_press.instruction_short_text: Cable shoulder press: Press cable handles from shoulder height to overhead, seated or standing between two low pulleys.
instruction_detail_text: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle at each shoulder.
Press both handles up until the arms are straight.
Lower under control to shoulder height.
common_faults: Letting the cables pull the arms wide

elevated_pike_push_up.instruction_short_text: Elevated pike push-up: With your feet on a box and hips high, lower your head towards the floor and press back up.
instruction_detail_text: Put your feet on a box and walk your hands back until your hips are over your shoulders.
Bend the elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor between your hands.
Press back up to straight arms.

cable_upright_row.instruction_short_text: Cable upright row: Pull a bar or rope from a low pulley up the front of the body, elbows leading, to lower-chest height.
instruction_detail_text: Stand close to a low pulley holding the bar or rope in front of the thighs.
Pull it up close to the body, elbows leading out and up, to lower-chest height.
Lower it under control.
coaching_cues: Wide enough grip to stay pain-free
common_faults: Narrow grip that pinches the shoulder

dumbbell_upright_row.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell upright row: Pull two dumbbells, or one, up the front of the body with the elbows leading to lower-chest height.
instruction_detail_text: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Lift them up close to the body, elbows leading, to lower-chest height.
Lower under control.

incline_dumbbell_lateral_raise.instruction_short_text: Incline lateral raise: Lie on your side on an incline bench and raise one dumbbell out to the side, under tension from the bottom.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side on a bench set at about 45 degrees, the dumbbell hanging in the top hand.
Raise it out to the side until the arm is about level with the shoulder.
Lower slowly to the start.

side_lying_lateral_raise.instruction_short_text: Side-lying lateral raise: Lie on your side on a flat bench and raise a dumbbell from in front of the hips to vertical.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side on a flat bench, the dumbbell in your top hand in front of the hips.
Raise it in an arc until the arm points straight up.
Lower under control.
common_faults: Bending the elbow more as it gets hard

cable_y_raise.instruction_short_text: Cable Y raise: From low pulleys crossed in front of you, raise both arms up and out into a Y above your head.
instruction_detail_text: Hold the left cable in the right hand and the right cable in the left hand, arms crossed low in front.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y, thumbs up.
Return under control.
coaching_cues: Arms in a Y, not a T

suspension_y_raise.instruction_short_text: Suspension Y raise: Lean back holding the straps and raise your straight arms into a Y to pull your body upright.
instruction_detail_text: Face the anchor, arms straight in front, and lean back to the prescribed angle.
Raise the arms up and out into a Y, pulling your body towards upright.
Lower back under control.

full_can_lateral_raise.instruction_short_text: Full-can raise: Raise light dumbbells, thumbs up, in a line about 30 degrees forward of the side, to shoulder height.
instruction_detail_text: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides, thumbs pointing forward.
Raise them, thumbs up, slightly forward of the side to shoulder height.
Lower under control.

barbell_rear_delt_row.instruction_short_text: Barbell rear delt row: Bent over with a wide grip, row the bar to the upper chest with the elbows flared out to the sides.
instruction_detail_text: Hinge forward with a flat back holding the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Row it to the upper chest, elbows out wide and level with the shoulders.
Lower under control.
common_faults: Elbows drifting to the sides of the body

dumbbell_rear_delt_row.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell rear delt row: Bent over or supported on a bench, row a dumbbell with the elbow flared out level with the shoulder.
instruction_detail_text: Support one hand and knee on a bench, the dumbbell hanging below the shoulder, palm facing back.
Row it up with the elbow flared out to the side.
Lower under control.
coaching_cues: Upper arm at 90 degrees to the body
Squeeze the back of the shoulder

cable_rear_delt_row.instruction_short_text: Cable rear delt row: Row a rope from a chest-height pulley towards the face with the elbows high and wide.
instruction_detail_text: Set a pulley at chest height and hold the rope with both hands, arms straight.
Row towards the face, elbows high and out wide.
Return under control.

machine_reverse_fly.instruction_short_text: Machine reverse fly: Facing the pad of a rear-delt (pec deck) machine, sweep the handles back in an arc to the sides.
instruction_detail_text: Sit facing the pad with the handles at shoulder height in front of you.
Sweep the arms back in an arc until they're in line with the body.
Return under control.
coaching_cues: Lead with the back of the hand
common_faults: Bending the elbows more to cheat

rear_delt_inverted_row.instruction_short_text: Rear delt inverted row: Hanging under a bar with a wide grip, pull your upper chest to the bar with the elbows flared.
instruction_detail_text: Lie under a bar set at hip height, grip it wide and hang with the body straight.
Pull your upper chest to the bar, elbows out wide.
Lower under control.

suspension_reverse_fly.instruction_short_text: Suspension reverse fly: Lean back holding the straps and open your straight arms out to the sides to pull yourself upright.
instruction_detail_text: Face the anchor with straight arms and lean back.
Open the arms out to the sides to pull your body upright.
Return under control.
coaching_cues: Squeeze the back of the shoulders
common_faults: Bending the elbows into a row

suspension_rear_delt_row.instruction_short_text: Suspension rear delt row: Lean back holding the straps and row with the elbows flared out level with the shoulders.
instruction_detail_text: Face the anchor, palms down, arms straight, and lean back.
Row yourself up with the elbows out wide.
Lower under control.

supported_dumbbell_external_rotation.instruction_short_text: Supported external rotation: With the elbow resting on a bench at shoulder height, rotate a light dumbbell from forward to upright.
instruction_detail_text: Rest your upper arm on a bench or pad at shoulder height, elbow bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate the forearm up until it points to the ceiling.
Lower under control.

machine_external_rotation.instruction_short_text: Machine external rotation: On a rotator-cuff machine, rotate the forearm outwards against the machine with the elbow fixed.
instruction_detail_text: Set the machine so the elbow sits against the pad at the prescribed height.
Rotate the forearm outwards through the comfortable range.
Return under control.

suspension_external_rotation.instruction_short_text: Suspension external rotation: Leaning back on the straps, elbows at shoulder height, rotate your forearms up to pull yourself upright.
instruction_detail_text: Face the anchor holding the handles, elbows up at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, and lean back.
Rotate the forearms up and back until they point up, pulling the body upright.
Return under control.

supine_dumbbell_internal_rotation.instruction_short_text: Supine internal rotation: Lying on your back, elbow at your side, rotate a light dumbbell from out to the side up and across.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back with the upper arm on the floor beside you and the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate the forearm up and across towards the body.
Lower out to the side under control.
coaching_cues: Upper arm stays on the floor

machine_internal_rotation.instruction_short_text: Machine internal rotation: On a rotator-cuff machine, rotate the forearm inwards against the machine with the elbow fixed.
instruction_detail_text: Set the machine so the elbow sits against the pad at the prescribed height.
Rotate the forearm inwards through the comfortable range.
Return under control.

triceps_dip.instruction_short_text: Triceps dip: On parallel bars with the body upright, lower until the upper arms are about level, then press to straight arms.
instruction_detail_text: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms and the body upright.
Bend the elbows, keeping them back and the body vertical, until the upper arms are about level.
Press back up to straight arms.
common_faults: Leaning forward into a chest dip
Going too deep for the shoulders

assisted_dip.instruction_short_text: Assisted dip: Dip on an assisted-dip machine, or with a band, so you lift only part of your bodyweight.
instruction_detail_text: Set the assistance, kneel or stand on the platform (or the band) and support yourself on the bars.
Lower until the upper arms are about level.
Press back up to straight arms.
coaching_cues: Less assistance as you get stronger

bench_dip.instruction_short_text: Bench dip: Hands on a bench behind you, lower your hips by bending the elbows, then press back up.
instruction_detail_text: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside the hips, and slide off with the legs out in front.
Bend the elbows to lower the hips until the upper arms are about level.
Press back up to straight arms.
coaching_cues: Bend the knees to make it easier

machine_dip.instruction_short_text: Machine dip: Seated in a dip machine, press the handles down to straight arms and let them back up under control.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the handles beside your hips, chest up.
Press down until the arms are straight.
Let the handles back up under control.

barbell_overhead_triceps_extension.instruction_short_text: Barbell overhead triceps extension: Hold a barbell overhead and bend only the elbows to lower it behind the head, then extend.
instruction_detail_text: Stand or sit with the bar overhead on straight arms, hands about shoulder-width.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar behind the head, upper arms still.
Extend back to straight arms.

dumbbell_overhead_triceps_extension.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension: Hold one dumbbell overhead in both hands and lower it behind the head by bending the elbows.
instruction_detail_text: Hold a dumbbell by one end in both hands, arms straight overhead.
Bend the elbows to lower it behind the head.
Extend back to straight arms.

single_arm_dumbbell_overhead_extension.instruction_short_text: Single-arm overhead extension: Hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand and lower it behind the head by bending the elbow.
instruction_detail_text: Hold the dumbbell overhead on a straight arm.
Bend the elbow to lower it behind the head, upper arm pointing up.
Extend back to straight.

cable_lying_triceps_extension.instruction_short_text: Cable lying triceps extension: Lying on a bench with a low cable behind your head, extend the elbows to bring the bar over the chest.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on a bench with your head towards a low pulley, holding the bar with the arms angled back over the head.
Extend the elbows until the arms are straight.
Bend the elbows to return under control.

single_arm_cable_pushdown.instruction_short_text: Single-arm pushdown: Push a single cable handle down from a high pulley to a straight arm, one arm at a time.
instruction_detail_text: Stand facing a high pulley holding a handle, elbow at your side.
Push the handle down until the arm is straight.
Let it back up under control.

dumbbell_kickback.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell kickback: Bent over with the upper arm by your side, straighten the elbow to swing the dumbbell back.
instruction_detail_text: Support yourself on a bench, upper arm alongside your body and elbow bent.
Straighten the elbow to bring the dumbbell back.
Bend it back under control.

close_grip_push_up.instruction_short_text: Close-grip push-up: A push-up with the hands under the shoulders or closer and the elbows tucked to the body.
instruction_detail_text: Set up in a push-up with the hands under or just inside the shoulders.
Lower the chest to the floor with the elbows close to the body.
Press back up to straight arms.

suspension_triceps_extension.instruction_short_text: Suspension triceps extension: Facing away from the anchor and leaning in, bend the elbows to lower your head between your hands, then extend.
instruction_detail_text: Face away from the anchor, arms straight out in front at shoulder height, and lean forward into the straps.
Bend only the elbows to lower your head between your hands.
Extend the elbows to push back up.

incline_dumbbell_curl.instruction_short_text: Incline dumbbell curl: Lying back on an incline bench with the arms hanging, curl the dumbbells up with the upper arms still.
instruction_detail_text: Sit back on a bench set at about 45 degrees, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up without moving the upper arms.
Lower all the way under control.

machine_curl.instruction_short_text: Machine curl: Curl the handles of a biceps machine with the upper arms on the pad.
instruction_detail_text: Set the seat so the elbows line up with the machine's pivot, upper arms on the pad.
Curl the handles up.
Lower under control to almost straight.

spider_curl.instruction_short_text: Spider curl: Lying face down on an incline bench with the arms hanging, curl the bar up with the upper arms vertical.
instruction_detail_text: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down holding the bar.
Curl it up keeping the upper arms vertical.
Lower under control.
common_faults: Lifting the chest off the bench

suspension_biceps_curl.instruction_short_text: Suspension curl: Lean back holding the straps, palms up, and curl your hands to your forehead to pull yourself up.
instruction_detail_text: Face the anchor, arms straight in front with palms up, and lean back.
Curl the hands towards the forehead, keeping the upper arms still.
Lower back under control.
common_faults: Dropping the elbows into a row

rope_hammer_curl.instruction_short_text: Rope hammer curl: Curl a rope from a low pulley with the palms facing each other.
instruction_detail_text: Stand facing a low pulley holding the rope ends, palms facing each other.
Curl the rope up, elbows at your sides.
Lower under control.

reverse_curl.instruction_short_text: Reverse curl: Curl a bar with an overhand (palms-down) grip.
instruction_detail_text: Stand holding the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl it up keeping the wrists straight and elbows at your sides.
Lower under control.

dumbbell_pronation.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell pronation: With the forearm resting on a bench, rotate a dumbbell held at one end from thumb-up to palm-down.
instruction_detail_text: Rest your forearm on a bench or your thigh with the hand over the edge, holding a dumbbell (or a weighted handle) by one end, thumb up.
Rotate the hand palm-down.
Return under control.
coaching_cues: Hold nearer the end to make it harder

dumbbell_supination.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell supination: With the forearm resting on a bench, rotate a dumbbell held at one end from thumb-up to palm-up.
instruction_detail_text: Rest your forearm on a bench or your thigh with the hand over the edge, holding a dumbbell by one end, thumb up.
Rotate the hand palm-up.
Return under control.
coaching_cues: Hold nearer the end to make it harder

grip_machine_squeeze.instruction_short_text: Grip machine: Squeeze the handles of a grip machine shut and open them under control.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the forearm supported and the fingers around the handle.
Squeeze the handle fully shut.
Let it open under control.

lying_plate_neck_flexion.display_label: Lying neck flexion with a plate
lying_plate_neck_flexion.instruction_short_text: Lying neck flexion: Lying on your back with your head off the end of a bench, nod your chin to your chest against a light plate on the forehead.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back with your head over the end of a bench and a light plate on a towel on your forehead, held with both hands.
Lower the head back slowly, then nod the chin towards the chest.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.

lying_plate_neck_lateral_flexion.display_label: Side-lying neck lateral flexion with a plate
lying_plate_neck_lateral_flexion.instruction_short_text: Side-lying neck flexion: Lying on your side with your head off the bench, raise your ear towards your shoulder against a light plate.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side with your head over the end of a bench and a light plate on a towel against the side of the head.
Lower the head towards the floor, then raise the ear towards the top shoulder.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.

neck_harness_extension.instruction_short_text: Neck harness extension: Bent over with a weighted harness on the head, lower the chin then raise the head back to neutral.
instruction_detail_text: Put on the harness with a light plate, hands on your knees and back flat.
Lower the chin towards the chest under control.
Raise the head back to neutral; don't throw it back.

machine_neck_flexion.instruction_short_text: Machine neck flexion: On a four-way neck machine, press your forehead into the pad and nod forward through a comfortable range.
instruction_detail_text: Set the seat so the pad sits on your forehead, facing the pad.
Nod forward against the pad.
Return slowly to neutral.

machine_neck_extension.instruction_short_text: Machine neck extension: On a four-way neck machine, press the back of your head into the pad and extend through a comfortable range.
instruction_detail_text: Set the seat so the pad sits on the back of your head, facing away.
Press the head back against the pad.
Return slowly to neutral.

machine_neck_lateral_flexion.instruction_short_text: Machine neck lateral flexion: On a four-way neck machine, press the side of your head into the pad and tilt through a comfortable range.
instruction_detail_text: Sit side-on with the pad against the side of your head.
Tilt the head sideways against the pad.
Return slowly to neutral; do both sides.

band_neck_retraction.instruction_short_text: Band neck retraction: With a band around the back of the head anchored in front, draw the head straight back into a chin tuck.
instruction_detail_text: Anchor a light band in front of you at head height and loop it behind your head.
Draw the head straight back, tucking the chin, without tilting.
Return slowly.
coaching_cues: Straight back, not up or down

chin_tuck.instruction_short_text: Lying chin tuck: Lying on your back, draw the chin in to flatten the back of the neck into the floor and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back with the head on the floor.
Draw the chin straight in as if making a double chin, pressing the back of the neck down.
Hold for the prescribed time and relax.

wall_neck_bridge_front.instruction_short_text: Wall front neck bridge: Lean your forehead on a cushioned wall with the body angled and hold your weight through the neck.
instruction_detail_text: Put a folded towel or pad on a wall and lean your forehead into it, feet a step back.
Hold the body straight with the neck neutral.
Hold for the prescribed time; step closer to make it easier.

wall_side_neck_bridge.instruction_short_text: Wall side neck bridge: Lean the side of your head on a cushioned wall with the body angled and hold your weight through the neck.
instruction_detail_text: Stand side-on to a padded wall and lean the side of your head into it, feet out from the wall.
Hold the body straight with the neck neutral.
Hold for the prescribed time and switch sides.

wall_rear_neck_bridge.instruction_short_text: Wall rear neck bridge: Lean the back of your head on a cushioned wall with the body angled and hold your weight through the neck.
instruction_detail_text: Stand with your back to a padded wall and lean the back of your head into it, feet out from the wall.
Hold the body straight with the neck neutral.
Hold for the prescribed time; step closer to make it easier.

underhand_barbell_row.instruction_short_text: Underhand barbell row: Bent over with a shoulder-width underhand grip, row the bar to the lower ribs.
instruction_detail_text: Hinge forward with a flat back holding the bar with palms facing forward.
Row it to the lower ribs, elbows close to the body.
Lower to straight arms under control.

smith_machine_bent_over_row.instruction_short_text: Smith machine row: Bent over under the Smith bar, row it to the lower chest and lower it under control.
instruction_detail_text: Set the bar at knee height, hinge forward and grip it shoulder-width.
Unhook and row to the lower chest.
Lower to straight arms and re-hook at the end.

single_arm_cable_row.instruction_short_text: Single-arm cable row: Row one cable handle to your side, seated or in a split stance, without twisting.
instruction_detail_text: Sit or stand side-on in a split stance holding a handle at arm's length.
Row the handle to your side, elbow close.
Return under control with a full reach.

wide_grip_seated_cable_row.instruction_short_text: Wide-grip cable row: Seated at a low pulley, row a wide bar to the lower chest with the elbows out.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with knees soft holding a long bar wide.
Row to the lower chest, elbows out and shoulder blades together.
Return under control.

machine_high_row.instruction_short_text: Machine high row: Pull the high handles of a row machine down and back towards the shoulders.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the chest on the pad or thighs under the pad, handles high in front.
Pull down and back, driving the elbows towards the hips.
Return under control.

feet_elevated_inverted_row.instruction_short_text: Feet-elevated inverted row: Hanging under a bar with your feet on a box, pull your chest to the bar.
instruction_detail_text: Hang under a bar set at hip height with your heels on a box and the body straight.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

underhand_inverted_row.instruction_short_text: Underhand inverted row: Hanging under a bar with palms facing you, pull your chest to the bar.
instruction_detail_text: Hang under a bar at hip height, palms facing you, body straight.
Pull your chest to the bar, elbows close.
Lower under control.

suspension_row.instruction_short_text: Suspension row: Lean back holding the straps and row your chest up to the handles.
instruction_detail_text: Face the anchor holding the handles and lean back with straight arms.
Row your chest up to the handles.
Lower under control; walk your feet forward to make it harder.

single_arm_suspension_row.instruction_short_text: Single-arm suspension row: Lean back on one strap and row yourself up without letting the body twist.
instruction_detail_text: Hold one handle, lean back with the arm straight and the free arm by your side.
Row yourself up without rotating.
Lower under control.

assisted_pull_up.instruction_short_text: Assisted pull-up: Do pull-ups or chin-ups on an assisted machine so you lift only part of your bodyweight.
instruction_detail_text: Set the assistance and kneel or stand on the platform, gripping the bar.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Lower to straight arms under control.
coaching_cues: Less help as you get stronger

neutral_grip_pull_up.instruction_short_text: Neutral-grip pull-up: Pull up on parallel handles with the palms facing each other.
instruction_detail_text: Hang from parallel handles with straight arms, palms facing.
Pull until your chin clears the handles.
Lower to a full hang.

archer_pull_up.instruction_short_text: Archer pull-up: With a very wide grip, pull up towards one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight.
instruction_detail_text: Hang from a wide overhand grip.
Pull towards one hand, keeping the other arm nearly straight along the bar.
Lower under control and alternate sides.

one_arm_pull_up.instruction_short_text: One-arm pull-up: Pull your chin over the bar with one arm.
instruction_detail_text: Hang from the bar with one hand, the body braced and still.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control.
coaching_cues: Pull the elbow to the ribs

ring_pull_up.instruction_short_text: Ring pull-up: Pull up on gymnastics rings, letting the hands turn naturally.
instruction_detail_text: Hang from the rings with straight arms.
Pull until your chin is over the rings, letting the palms turn in.
Lower to a full hang.
coaching_cues: Rings close to the body at the top

underhand_lat_pulldown.instruction_short_text: Underhand pulldown: Pull a bar down to the upper chest with a shoulder-width, palms-facing-you grip.
instruction_detail_text: Sit under the pulley with the thighs pinned, holding the bar palms towards you, shoulder-width.
Pull it to the upper chest, elbows down and back.
Return to straight arms.

straight_arm_pulldown.instruction_short_text: Straight-arm pulldown: Standing at a high pulley, sweep a bar from overhead down to the thighs with straight arms.
instruction_detail_text: Stand facing a high pulley, hinge slightly and hold the bar with straight arms at eye level.
Sweep it down to the thighs keeping the arms straight.
Return under control.
coaching_cues: Drive the bar to the thighs
common_faults: Bending the elbows into a pushdown

machine_pullover.instruction_short_text: Machine pullover: Sweep the arm pads of a pullover machine from overhead down to your trunk.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the elbows on the pads and the arms raised overhead.
Drive the elbows down in an arc to your sides.
Return under control to the stretch.

barbell_pullover.instruction_short_text: Barbell pullover: Lying on a bench, lower a barbell in an arc behind your head with soft elbows, then pull it back over the chest.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on a bench holding a barbell over the chest with a narrow grip and soft elbows.
Lower it in an arc behind the head to a comfortable stretch.
Pull it back over the chest.
common_faults: Bending the elbows into a press

machine_shrug.instruction_short_text: Machine shrug: Shrug the handles of a shrug machine or Smith bar straight up and lower them under control.
instruction_detail_text: Stand or sit in the machine holding the handles with straight arms.
Shrug the shoulders straight up towards the ears.
Lower under control to a full stretch.

inverted_shrug.instruction_short_text: Inverted shrug: Hanging under a low bar with straight arms, pull the shoulder blades together and down to lift the chest slightly.
instruction_detail_text: Hang under a bar at hip height with straight arms and the body straight.
Without bending the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades back to lift the chest.
Lower under control.

dumbbell_fly.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell fly: Lying on a bench, open the arms in a wide arc with soft elbows, then bring the dumbbells together over the chest.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on a bench with the dumbbells over the chest, palms facing and elbows slightly bent.
Open the arms in a wide arc to a comfortable chest stretch.
Squeeze them back together over the chest.

incline_dumbbell_fly.instruction_short_text: Incline dumbbell fly: On an incline bench, open the arms in a wide arc with soft elbows, then bring the dumbbells together.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on a bench at about 30 degrees with the dumbbells over the chest, palms facing.
Open the arms in a wide arc to a comfortable stretch.
Squeeze them back together.

cable_fly.instruction_short_text: Cable fly: Standing between two pulleys, bring the handles together in front of the chest in a wide arc.
instruction_detail_text: Stand in a split stance between two pulleys set at shoulder height or above, arms open.
Bring the handles together in front of the chest with soft elbows.
Open under control.
common_faults: Letting the cables pull the arms back too far

low_to_high_cable_fly.instruction_short_text: Low-to-high cable fly: From low pulleys, sweep the handles up and together to upper-chest height.
instruction_detail_text: Stand between two low pulleys holding the handles by your hips.
Sweep them up and together in front of the upper chest.
Return under control.
common_faults: Turning it into a front raise

lying_cable_fly.instruction_short_text: Lying cable fly: On a bench between two low pulleys, bring the handles together over the chest in a wide arc.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys, handles in each hand, arms open.
Bring the handles together over the chest with soft elbows.
Open under control.

pec_deck_fly.instruction_short_text: Pec deck: Seated in a fly machine, bring the handles or pads together in front of the chest.
instruction_detail_text: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height and sit with the back on the pad.
Bring the handles together in front of the chest.
Open under control to a comfortable stretch.

standing_cable_chest_press.instruction_short_text: Standing cable chest press: Facing away from two pulleys, press the handles forward from the chest in a split stance.
instruction_detail_text: Stand in a split stance facing away from two chest-height pulleys, handles at the chest.
Press forward until the arms are straight.
Return under control.
common_faults: Letting the cables pull you back

machine_decline_chest_press.instruction_short_text: Machine decline press: Press the low handles of a decline press machine forward and down from the lower chest.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the back on the pad and the handles at lower-chest height.
Press until the arms are straight.
Return under control.

smith_machine_bench_press.instruction_short_text: Smith machine bench press: Lower the Smith bar to the mid-chest from a flat bench and press it back up.
instruction_detail_text: Set a flat bench so the bar lowers to the mid-chest.
Unhook, lower the bar to the chest under control.
Press back to straight arms and re-hook at the end.
coaching_cues: Bench set so the bar meets mid-chest

smith_machine_incline_press.instruction_short_text: Smith machine incline press: Lower the Smith bar to the upper chest from an incline bench and press it back up.
instruction_detail_text: Set an incline bench so the bar lowers to the upper chest.
Unhook and lower to the upper chest.
Press back to straight arms.

knee_push_up.instruction_short_text: Knee push-up: A push-up from the knees with the body straight from knees to head.
instruction_detail_text: Kneel with the hands under the shoulders and the body straight from knees to head.
Lower the chest to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
coaching_cues: Straight line from knees to head

archer_push_up.instruction_short_text: Archer push-up: With the hands wide, lower towards one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight.
instruction_detail_text: Set up in a wide push-up.
Lower towards one hand, keeping the other arm nearly straight.
Press back up and alternate sides.

suspension_push_up.instruction_short_text: Suspension push-up: Facing away from the anchor, lean into the straps and lower the chest between the handles, then press back.
instruction_detail_text: Face away from the anchor holding the handles, arms straight in front, leaning forward.
Lower the chest between the handles, keeping them steady.
Press back to straight arms.

suspension_fly.instruction_short_text: Suspension fly: Leaning into the straps with straight arms, open them out to the sides and squeeze back together.
instruction_detail_text: Face away from the anchor, leaning forward with straight arms in front.
Open the arms out to the sides as your chest lowers.
Squeeze them back together to rise.
common_faults: Bending the elbows into a press

ring_dip.instruction_short_text: Ring dip: Support yourself on rings with straight arms, lower until the upper arms are about level, then press up.
instruction_detail_text: Support yourself on the rings with straight arms, rings close to the body.
Lower until the upper arms are about level, keeping the rings in.
Press back to straight arms, turning the rings out at the top.

incline_shoulder_raise.instruction_short_text: Incline shoulder raise: Lying on an incline bench with straight arms, push the bar higher by reaching the shoulders forward.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on an incline bench holding a bar or dumbbells over the chest with straight arms.
Without bending the elbows, reach the shoulders up off the bench.
Lower the shoulder blades back under control.

crunch.instruction_short_text: Crunch: Lying on your back with knees bent, curl the shoulders off the floor towards the hips.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat, hands across the chest or by the ears.
Curl the head and shoulders up, bringing the ribs towards the hips.
Lower under control.

decline_crunch.instruction_short_text: Decline crunch: On a decline bench with the feet hooked, curl the shoulders up towards the hips.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on a decline bench with the feet secured.
Curl the head and shoulders up towards the hips.
Lower under control; hold a plate to make it harder.
coaching_cues: Breathe out on the way up

stability_ball_crunch.instruction_short_text: Ball crunch: Lying back over a stability ball, curl the ribs towards the hips through the full range.
instruction_detail_text: Sit on a stability ball and walk forward until it supports your lower and mid back.
Let the back extend over the ball, then curl the ribs towards the hips.
Lower back over the ball under control.

sit_up.instruction_short_text: Sit-up: From lying with knees bent, curl up to sitting and lower back down under control.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat (anchored if needed).
Curl up, ribs first, until you're sitting upright.
Lower back down one vertebra at a time.

decline_sit_up.instruction_short_text: Decline sit-up: On a decline bench with the feet hooked, curl up to sitting and lower back down under control.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on a decline bench with the feet secured.
Curl up to sitting.
Lower back down under control; hold a plate to load it.

ghd_sit_up.instruction_short_text: GHD sit-up: Seated on a glute-ham developer, lean back to about parallel, then sit up powerfully.
instruction_detail_text: Sit on the GHD with the feet hooked and the hips just off the pad.
Lean back to about parallel (further only once well trained).
Sit up by driving the knees straight and reaching forward.

standing_cable_crunch.instruction_short_text: Standing cable crunch: Facing away from a high pulley, hold the rope by your head and crunch the ribs down towards the hips.
instruction_detail_text: Stand facing away from a high pulley, rope held beside the head.
Crunch the ribs down towards the hips without bending at the hips.
Return under control.

machine_crunch.instruction_short_text: Machine crunch: Seated in an ab machine, crunch the ribs towards the hips against the pads.
instruction_detail_text: Sit in the machine with the pads or handles at the chest or shoulders.
Crunch forward, curling the ribs towards the hips.
Return under control.

weighted_reach_crunch.instruction_short_text: Reach crunch: Lying on your back holding a weight over the chest, crunch up and reach it towards the ceiling.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a dumbbell or plate over the chest with straight arms.
Crunch up, reaching the weight towards the ceiling.
Lower under control.

hanging_knee_raise.instruction_short_text: Hanging knee raise: Hanging from a bar, raise the knees towards the chest by curling the pelvis up.
instruction_detail_text: Hang from a bar with straight arms and the body still.
Raise the knees towards the chest, curling the pelvis up at the top.
Lower under control without swinging.
common_faults: Only lifting the knees to hip height

hanging_leg_raise.instruction_short_text: Hanging leg raise: Hanging from a bar, raise straight legs to at least horizontal while curling the pelvis up.
instruction_detail_text: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Raise straight legs to horizontal or higher, curling the pelvis.
Lower under control.
coaching_cues: Curl the pelvis at the top

hanging_oblique_knee_raise.instruction_short_text: Hanging oblique knee raise: Hanging from a bar, raise the knees up and across towards one shoulder.
instruction_detail_text: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Raise the knees up and across towards one shoulder.
Lower under control and alternate sides.

captains_chair_knee_raise.instruction_short_text: Captain's chair: Supported on the forearms in a knee-raise station, raise the knees towards the chest.
instruction_detail_text: Support yourself on the forearm pads with the back against the pad.
Raise the knees towards the chest, curling the pelvis.
Lower under control.

lying_leg_raise.instruction_short_text: Lying leg raise: Lying on your back, raise straight legs to vertical and lower them slowly without arching.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back, hands under the hips or holding a bench behind the head.
Raise straight legs to vertical.
Lower slowly, keeping the lower back down.
coaching_cues: Bend the knees to make it easier

seated_knee_tuck.instruction_short_text: Seated knee tuck: Sitting on a bench leaning back on your hands, draw the knees in to the chest and extend them out.
instruction_detail_text: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands behind you, leaning back with the legs out straight.
Draw the knees in to the chest while sitting up slightly.
Extend the legs back out.
coaching_cues: Keep the feet off the floor

ab_wheel_rollout.instruction_short_text: Ab wheel rollout: From the knees, roll the wheel forward as far as you can control without arching, then pull back.
instruction_detail_text: Kneel holding the wheel under the shoulders.
Roll forward, keeping the ribs down and the back flat.
Pull back to the start using the abs and lats.
coaching_cues: Only as far as you control

suspension_jack_knife.instruction_short_text: Suspension jack-knife: In a push-up position with the feet in the straps, draw the knees in to the chest and push them back out.
instruction_detail_text: Set up in a push-up position with the feet in the straps.
Draw the knees in towards the chest.
Push the legs back out to a straight plank.

suspension_pike.instruction_short_text: Suspension pike: In a push-up position with the feet in the straps, lift the hips high with straight legs, then lower to a plank.
instruction_detail_text: Set up in a push-up position with the feet in the straps.
Keeping the legs straight, raise the hips towards the ceiling.
Lower back to a straight plank.

suspension_mountain_climber.instruction_short_text: Suspension mountain climber: In a push-up position with the feet in the straps, drive one knee then the other towards the chest.
instruction_detail_text: Set up in a push-up position with the feet in the straps.
Drive one knee towards the chest, then switch.
Keep alternating at the prescribed pace.

abdominal_vacuum.instruction_short_text: Abdominal vacuum: After a full exhale, draw the belly button in towards the spine and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Kneel, stand or lie down and breathe all the way out.
Draw the belly button in towards the spine and hold.
Hold for the prescribed time, breathing shallowly, then relax.
common_faults: Holding the breath with a full chest

twisting_crunch.instruction_short_text: Twisting crunch: Crunch up and rotate one shoulder towards the opposite knee, alternating sides.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands by the ears.
Crunch up and rotate, bringing one shoulder towards the opposite knee.
Lower and alternate sides.

side_crunch.instruction_short_text: Side crunch: Lying on your side, crunch the ribs towards the hip.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side with the legs stacked or slightly bent, top hand by the ear.
Crunch the top ribs towards the hip, lifting the shoulder.
Lower under control; switch sides.

russian_twist.instruction_short_text: Russian twist: Sitting leaning back with the feet up or down, rotate a ball from side to side.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the knees bent, lean back with a straight back and hold a ball at the chest.
Rotate the shoulders to bring the ball beside one hip, then the other.
Keep the back straight throughout.
coaching_cues: Rotate the ribs, not just the arms
Feet down to make it easier

landmine_rotation.instruction_short_text: Landmine rotation: Holding the end of a landmine bar overhead with straight arms, rotate it down to one hip, then the other.
instruction_detail_text: Stand facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at forehead height with straight arms.
Rotate the trunk and pivot the feet to bring the bar down beside one hip.
Return through the middle to the other side.
common_faults: Letting the bar pull you round

machine_torso_rotation.instruction_short_text: Machine torso rotation: Seated in a rotary torso machine, rotate against the pads and return under control.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the chest against the pads and the hips locked in.
Rotate the trunk through a comfortable range.
Return under control and do both sides.

dumbbell_side_bend.instruction_short_text: Side bend: Holding a dumbbell in one hand, bend sideways towards it, then pull back up with the other side.
instruction_detail_text: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side.
Bend sideways towards the weight.
Pull back up to upright with the opposite side; switch sides.
coaching_cues: Pull up with the other side
common_faults: Using a dumbbell in each hand

back_extension_side_bend.instruction_short_text: 45-degree side bend: Lying sideways on a back-extension bench, lower the trunk towards the floor and raise it back up.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side on a 45-degree back-extension bench, hip on the pad, feet secured.
Lower the trunk sideways towards the floor.
Raise it back to straight.
coaching_cues: Hold a plate to load it

short_side_plank.instruction_short_text: Bent-knee side plank: Support yourself on one forearm and the knees with the body straight from knees to head.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side with the knees bent and the elbow under the shoulder.
Lift the hips so the body is straight from knees to head.
Hold for the prescribed time; switch sides.

machine_back_extension.instruction_short_text: Machine back extension: Seated in a back-extension machine, extend the trunk back against the pad and return under control.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the pad across the upper back and the hips secured.
Extend back against the pad.
Return under control.

superman.instruction_short_text: Superman: Lying face down, lift the arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor and hold.
instruction_detail_text: Lie face down with the arms overhead.
Lift the arms, chest and legs slightly off the floor, looking at the floor.
Hold for the prescribed time, or lift opposite arm and leg alternately.

stability_ball_back_extension.instruction_short_text: Ball back extension: Lying face down over a stability ball with the feet against a wall, extend the trunk up to straight.
instruction_detail_text: Lie face down over a ball with the hips on it and the feet against a wall.
Lower the chest around the ball, then extend up until the body is straight.
Lower under control.

cable_pull_through.instruction_short_text: Pull-through: Facing away from a low pulley with the rope between the legs, hinge back, then drive the hips forward to stand.
instruction_detail_text: Stand facing away from a low pulley holding the rope between the legs.
Hinge back at the hips with a flat back.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.
coaching_cues: Squeeze the glutes at the top

single_leg_glute_bridge.instruction_short_text: Single-leg glute bridge: Lying on your back with one foot down, drive the hips up through that heel until straight.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg raised.
Drive through the heel to lift the hips until the body is straight.
Lower under control; switch sides.

single_leg_hip_thrust.instruction_short_text: Single-leg hip thrust: Shoulders on a bench and one foot down, drive the hips up to straight.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the upper back against a bench, one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Drive through the heel to raise the hips until the body is straight.
Lower under control; switch sides.

machine_glute_kickback.instruction_short_text: Machine kickback: On a glute kickback machine, drive one leg back against the pad until the hip is straight.
instruction_detail_text: Set up on the machine with the working foot or knee against the pad.
Drive the leg back until the hip is fully extended.
Return under control.

machine_hip_thrust.instruction_short_text: Machine hip thrust: In a hip-thrust machine with the belt or pad over the hips, drive the hips up to straight.
instruction_detail_text: Set up with the back on the pad and the belt or pad across the hips.
Drive through the heels to raise the hips.
Lower under control.

side_lying_hip_abduction.instruction_short_text: Side-lying hip abduction: Lying on your side, raise the straight top leg slightly behind the body and lower it slowly.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side with the bottom knee bent and the top leg straight.
Raise the top leg, slightly behind the body, toes forward.
Lower slowly.

side_plank_hip_abduction.instruction_short_text: Side plank hip abduction: Holding a side plank, raise and lower the top leg.
instruction_detail_text: Hold a side plank on your forearm and the bottom foot.
Raise the top leg, toes forward.
Lower under control; switch sides.

cable_hip_internal_rotation.instruction_short_text: Hip internal rotation: Seated with the knee bent and a cable around the ankle, rotate the foot outwards.
instruction_detail_text: Sit on a bench with the knees bent at 90 degrees and a low cable cuffed to the ankle from the inside.
Rotate the foot outwards, keeping the thigh still.
Return under control.

cable_hip_external_rotation.instruction_short_text: Hip external rotation: Seated with the knee bent and a cable around the ankle, rotate the foot inwards.
instruction_detail_text: Sit on a bench with the knees bent at 90 degrees and a low cable cuffed to the ankle from the outside.
Rotate the foot inwards, keeping the thigh still.
Return under control.

side_lying_hip_adduction.instruction_short_text: Side-lying hip adduction: Lying on your side with the top leg crossed in front, raise the straight bottom leg.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your side with the top foot planted in front of the bottom knee.
Raise the straight bottom leg off the floor.
Lower slowly.

safety_bar_squat.instruction_short_text: Safety bar squat: Squat with a safety squat bar on the upper back, holding its handles in front, to the prescribed depth.
instruction_detail_text: Set the bar in the rack, step under so the pads sit on the upper back and hold the handles.
Brace and squat to the prescribed depth, staying tall against the bar's forward pull.
Drive up to standing.
coaching_cues: Push the upper back into the bar

smith_machine_squat.instruction_short_text: Smith machine squat: Squat with the Smith bar on the upper back, feet slightly in front of the bar, to the prescribed depth.
instruction_detail_text: Set the bar at shoulder height, step under it and place the feet slightly forward.
Unhook, brace and squat to the prescribed depth.
Drive up to standing and re-hook at the end.

dumbbell_squat.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell squat: Holding a dumbbell at each side, squat to the prescribed depth with the chest up.
instruction_detail_text: Stand holding a dumbbell at each side.
Squat to the prescribed depth, keeping the chest up and the dumbbells hanging.
Drive up to standing.

v_squat.instruction_short_text: V-squat: Squat in a V-squat or pendulum machine with the shoulders under the pads.
instruction_detail_text: Set your shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform.
Squat to the prescribed depth.
Drive back up without locking out hard.

seated_leg_press.instruction_short_text: Seated leg press: Seated in a selectorised leg press, push the platform away to nearly straight legs and return under control.
instruction_detail_text: Sit with the back on the pad and the feet hip-width on the platform.
Push the platform away until the legs are nearly straight.
Return under control to the prescribed depth.
common_faults: Lower back peeling off the pad

single_leg_press.instruction_short_text: Single-leg press: Press the leg-press platform with one leg at a time.
instruction_detail_text: Set up in the leg press with one foot in the middle of the platform.
Lower under control to the prescribed depth.
Press back up; switch legs.

pistol_squat.instruction_short_text: Pistol squat: Squat all the way down on one leg with the other leg held straight out in front, then stand.
instruction_detail_text: Stand on one leg with the other leg out in front.
Squat down on the standing leg as deep as you can control, arms forward.
Drive back up to standing; hold a support or squat to a box to make it easier.

single_leg_box_squat.instruction_short_text: Single-leg box squat: On one leg, sit back to touch a box behind you and stand back up.
instruction_detail_text: Stand on one leg in front of a box, the other leg slightly forward.
Sit back under control until you touch the box.
Stand back up without rocking.
coaching_cues: Lower box as you get stronger

step_down.instruction_short_text: Step-down: Standing on a box on one leg, slowly lower the other heel to touch the floor, then stand back up.
instruction_detail_text: Stand on one leg on a low box, the other foot hanging off the side or front.
Bend the standing knee to lower the free heel to the floor slowly.
Tap and stand back up.

barbell_reverse_lunge.instruction_short_text: Barbell reverse lunge: With a bar on the upper back, step back into a lunge and drive back up to standing.
instruction_detail_text: Unrack the bar onto the upper back and stand tall.
Step back and lower the back knee towards the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand; alternate or finish one side.

smith_machine_split_squat.instruction_short_text: Smith split squat: In a split stance under the Smith bar, lower the back knee towards the floor and drive back up.
instruction_detail_text: Set the bar on the upper back in a split stance, front foot a little forward of the bar.
Lower the back knee towards the floor.
Drive back up; finish one side, then switch.

suspension_single_leg_squat.instruction_short_text: Suspension single-leg squat: Holding the straps for balance and a little help, squat on one leg and stand back up.
instruction_detail_text: Face the anchor holding the handles, standing on one leg.
Squat down on the standing leg, using the straps only as much as you need.
Stand back up.

supported_squat.instruction_short_text: Supported squat: Holding a fixed support in front of you, squat to a comfortable depth and stand back up.
instruction_detail_text: Hold a rack, doorframe or straps at chest height.
Sit back into a squat, using the support for balance.
Stand back up.
coaching_cues: Use the support for balance only

reverse_nordic.instruction_short_text: Reverse Nordic: Kneeling upright, lean back as one straight line from knees to head, then pull back up with the quads.
instruction_detail_text: Kneel upright on a pad with the hips straight.
Lean back slowly, keeping the hips straight, as far as you can control.
Pull back up with the thighs; use a band from in front to make it easier.
coaching_cues: Only as far as you control

dumbbell_romanian_deadlift.instruction_short_text: Dumbbell RDL: Holding dumbbells in front of the thighs, hinge at the hips with soft knees until you feel a hamstring stretch, then stand.
instruction_detail_text: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Push the hips back with soft knees, sliding the dumbbells down the legs.
Stand back up by driving the hips forward.

forty_five_degree_back_extension.instruction_short_text: 45-degree hip extension: On a 45-degree back-extension bench, hinge down at the hips and raise the body back to straight.
instruction_detail_text: Set the pad just below the hips with the feet secured.
Hinge down at the hips with a flat back.
Raise the body back to a straight line; hold a plate to load it.
common_faults: Rounding the back to go lower

standing_leg_curl.instruction_short_text: Standing leg curl: Standing in a leg curl machine, curl one heel up towards the glutes and lower it under control.
instruction_detail_text: Stand in the machine with the pad behind the lower calf.
Curl the heel towards the glutes.
Lower under control; switch legs.

stability_ball_leg_curl.instruction_short_text: Ball leg curl: Lying on your back with the heels on a stability ball and hips up, curl the ball in towards you.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back with the heels on a ball and lift the hips into a bridge.
Curl the ball towards you, keeping the hips up.
Roll it back out under control.

suspension_leg_curl.instruction_short_text: Suspension leg curl: Lying on your back with the heels in the straps and hips up, curl the heels towards the glutes.
instruction_detail_text: Lie under the anchor with the heels in the straps and lift the hips.
Curl the heels towards the glutes, keeping the hips up.
Extend back out under control.

single_leg_hamstring_bridge.instruction_short_text: Hamstring bridge: Lying on your back with one heel on a bench and the knee nearly straight, lift the hips.
instruction_detail_text: Lie on your back with one heel on a bench, knee slightly bent, other leg raised.
Drive the heel down to lift the hips.
Lower under control; switch sides.

leg_press_calf_raise.instruction_short_text: Leg press calf raise: In a leg press with the balls of the feet on the platform edge, press through the toes and lower for a stretch.
instruction_detail_text: Sit in the leg press with straight legs and the balls of the feet on the bottom edge.
Press the platform away by pointing the toes.
Lower for a full stretch.

donkey_calf_raise.instruction_short_text: Donkey calf raise: Bent forward at the hips with the balls of the feet on a step, raise and lower the heels.
instruction_detail_text: Lean forward on a support, hips bent, balls of the feet on a step or donkey-calf machine.
Raise the heels as high as you can.
Lower for a full stretch.

smith_machine_calf_raise.instruction_short_text: Smith calf raise: With the Smith bar on the upper back and the balls of the feet on a step, raise and lower the heels.
instruction_detail_text: Stand under the bar with the balls of the feet on a step or plate.
Raise the heels as high as you can.
Lower for a full stretch.

seated_dumbbell_tibialis_raise.instruction_short_text: Seated tibialis raise: Sitting with a dumbbell held between the feet, raise the toes towards the shins.
instruction_detail_text: Sit on a bench with a light dumbbell held vertically between the feet.
Raise the toes towards the shins.
Lower under control.
